mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in the past month signals a loosening of monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS decrease and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the past two months indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increase and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real gross domestic product (GDPC1) over the past quarter indicates strong economic demand, which typically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or the correlation between GDPC1 growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past two months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face production challenges.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between INDPRO decrease and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the past month, it indicates a strong labor market recovery, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% and retail and food services sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% in the past two months, it signals a strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% and RSAFS increases > 1% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in the past month signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL increase and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real gross domestic product (GDPC1) over the past quarter, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in the past two months, signals a robust economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of GDPC1 increase and UNRATE decrease on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
